turns:
Write a function `top_n(items: list[tuple[str, int]], n: int) -> list[tuple[str, int]]` returning the n items with the highest integer score.
The items list is ordered; when two items have equal scores, the item appearing earlier in the original list must also appear earlier in the result (stable order).
When n is 0 or negative, return an empty list -- do NOT return the whole list.
Do not mutate the input list.
